prompts.text: Would you rather have the ability to fly or be invisible?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes early or always be 20 minutes late?
Would you rather live in a tiny house with a beautiful view or a mansion with no windows?
Would you rather only eat sweet food or only eat salty food for the rest of your life?
Would you rather be able to talk to animals or speak every human language?
Would you rather have a pause button for life or a rewind button?
Would you rather always know what time it is or always know where you are?
Would you rather have unlimited money with no friends or be broke with an amazing social life?
Would you rather read minds or see the future?
Would you rather fight 100 duck-sized horses or one horse-sized duck?
Would you rather always be cold or always be hot?
Would you rather never use social media again or never watch TV again?
Would you rather have a photographic memory or be able to forget anything you choose?
Would you rather live in a world with magic or a world with highly advanced technology?
Would you rather only ever listen to one song or never listen to music again?
Would you rather have the power of super strength or super speed?
Would you rather explore the deep ocean or outer space?
Would you rather have hiccups for the rest of your life or always feel like you need to sneeze?
Would you rather be famous for something embarrassing or completely unknown?
Would you rather live in the past or in the future?
Would you rather know the exact date of your death or never know but live 20 extra years?
Would you rather always say everything you think or never be able to speak again?
Would you rather have your most embarrassing moment broadcast to everyone you know or lose all your money?
Would you rather be loved by someone you do not love or love someone who does not love you back?
Would you rather have everyone know your biggest secret or never be able to tell a secret to anyone?
Would you rather lose all your memories from the past five years or lose all your photos and videos forever?
Would you rather find out your best friend has been lying to you for years or find out a family secret you cannot unknow?
Would you rather be wildly successful but completely alone or average but surrounded by people who love you?
Would you rather always know when someone is lying or always be believed no matter what you say?
Would you rather lose all your closest friends tomorrow or never be able to make new friends again?
Would you rather be the smartest person in every room or the most liked person in every room?
Would you rather have the ability to erase a memory of yours or erase a memory of someone else's?
Would you rather live a comfortable but ordinary life or a thrilling but uncertain life?
Would you rather always be honest even when it hurts or tell white lies to protect people's feelings?
Would you rather re-live your teenage years knowing what you know now or skip ahead 10 years into the future?
Would you rather be the person who always gives advice or the person who always receives it?
Would you rather have your dream job but hate where you live or live exactly where you want but hate your job?
Would you rather know when a friendship is going to end before it does or be surprised every time?
Would you rather be 100 percent confident in yourself but secretly doubt everything or appear uncertain but feel deeply sure of who you are?
Would you rather always feel understood but never be surprised or never feel fully understood but always be intrigued?
Would you rather date someone incredibly attractive but boring or someone average-looking but endlessly interesting?
Would you rather know every person your partner has ever been attracted to or keep it all a mystery?
Would you rather have one perfect love story that ends in heartbreak or many mediocre relationships that never hurt?
Would you rather never have a breakup but settle for less or have your heart broken multiple times chasing the real thing?
Would you rather be in a relationship with no passion but total security or intense passion but constant uncertainty?
Would you rather know if someone finds you attractive immediately or never know at all?
Would you rather always be the one who cares more in a relationship or always be the one who cares less?
Would you rather confess feelings to someone and get rejected or never confess and always wonder?
Would you rather find out your current partner has a secret past or find out your best friend has feelings for them?
Would you rather be with someone who is painfully honest about your flaws or someone who never criticizes you but secretly judges?
Would you rather fall in love fast and hard or slow and deep?
Would you rather have a relationship that burns bright for two years or one that quietly lasts a lifetime?
Would you rather be with someone everyone disapproves of but who is perfect for you or someone everyone loves but who makes you feel invisible?
Would you rather know your partner's true opinion of you or keep the idealized version alive?
Would you rather lose feelings for someone slowly or have them end everything overnight?
Would you rather be in a relationship where you are the one who loves more or the one who is loved more?
Would you rather fall for someone completely wrong for you or never feel that intense connection again?
Would you rather be with someone who always knows the right thing to say or someone who says nothing but always stays?
Would you rather always know the truth about how a relationship ended or hold onto a beautiful lie?
Would you rather know exactly what love feels like and have to wait years for it or feel it now and realize it was not quite right?
